limitations: No policy selection or additional inferential family was performed after labels were opened. All reported intervals are the original frozen evaluator outputs.
The two passed hard-versus-soft criteria are exact identity cases, not strict improvements or evidence of a useful additional constraint.

All hard candidates start from zero-feasible tangent problems, retain strict future probe slack, and share terminal states with matched soft candidates; no binding-retention or infeasible regime was observed.

Empirical mean retention on old_validation and old_test is observed for every branch, but the predeclared old_test versus warmup bootstrap intervals still cross0 for both Heads. Finite-cohort average retention does not establish population, per-example or per-class retention.
Three fixed fitted seeds share data; the source bootstrap does not estimate seed-population variability. Anchors0/8/16 lie on the same uncontrolled trajectory and are not independent tasks.
Primary intervals are approximate class-stratified percentile bootstrap intervals with Bonferroni adjustment over8 tests. The96 secondary intervals are pointwise95% without family-wide confirmation.
Future sources are48/128/64 components across three historical months, averaged equally by month. Old independent validation and final each have64 components from April2014.

All19 methods at anchor16 have identical reported accuracy within each seed/Head/role; observed differences concern probability quality/NLL. Small NLL point differences are not a demonstrated accuracy gain.
Most improvement relative to old warmup is also present in the shared ordinary current-task Adam path. Extra intervention effects must be compared against zero from the same complete state.

This is one Cell, one fixed shared real Encoder, a label-independent384-to8 projection, two small Heads, a single bounded post-Adam intervention, and eight future full-batch deterministic steps with Q=0. It does not establish sustained feedback efficacy, multi-Cell behavior, large-model training benefit or pretraining-unseen generalization.

A parameter-field model may predict finite-candidate order without establishing that its chosen candidate improves heldout outcomes. Mechanism/ranking evidence and independent efficacy are separate endpoints.

primary.interpretation: Only the two hard-versus-soft old-test weak noninferiority criteria pass, both exact0 with interval[0,0]. Neither future-benefit criterion nor hard-versus-warmup retention criterion passes for either Head.

retention.interpretation: All342 branches, including18 zero branches, satisfy all three empirical future-step mean-retention checks. All108 hard/soft pairs have identical complete terminal-state digests and external metrics. This environment does not demonstrate added value from binding hard retention constraints or discriminate probe-to-independent-retention failures.

secondary.interpretation: Eight pointwise95% intervals exclude0, all NLL improvements. Six are Full-versus-Loss2 rows, with hard/soft duplicates; two are linear August direct/tracking versus zero. No multiplicity-adjusted secondary-family claim.

run_audit.scope: declared tangent arithmetic and actual finite Adam paths; no nonlinear global or population guarantee

ranking.scope: fixed finite candidate pools; no independent-anchor inference

score_audit.scope: source-conditional approximate intervals; distinct diagnostics, no unified policy utility guarantee
